label: lem:strongly_measurable_interior
title: Strong measurability at interior points
statement: If $f$ is continuous on $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$ and $x$ lies in the open interior, then $f$ is strongly measurable at $\texttt{nhds}\; x$. This follows from \texttt{ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter} via \texttt{isOpen\_Ioo}.
proof: The open interval is a neighborhood of $x$, so the claim reduces to strong measurability on a compact set, which is automatic from continuity.
